g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Figure fleet-100-1 · Every panel has its own denominator; these are not the same 100 vehicles. Ontario MTO size/model marginals do not establish powertrain. StatCan shares are independent new-registration snapshots. n = # of symbols. Percentages are rounded to 0.01%; exact counts and shares remain in the table. Symbols use largest remainders.'

text.tspan: Figure fleet-100-1 · Every panel has its own denominator; these are not the same 100 vehicles.
Ontario MTO size/model marginals do not establish powertrain. StatCan shares are independent new-registration snapshots.
n = # of symbols. Percentages are rounded to 0.01%; exact counts and shares remain in the table. Symbols use largest remainders.
